# Research Plan: CDC 2022 Death Rates by US State

## Goal
Identify US states that had ALL THREE of these death rates in 2022 (per CDC data):
- Heart disease > 191.5 per 100,000
- Cancer > 161.9 per 100,000
- Diabetes > 33.1 per 100,000

## Components
1. CDC 2022 age-adjusted death rates for heart disease by state
2. CDC 2022 age-adjusted death rates for cancer by state
3. CDC 2022 age-adjusted death rates for diabetes by state
3. Cross-reference all three to find states meeting all thresholds

## Constraints
- Use official CDC WONDER / CDC Data Hub / NCHS data
- Age-adjusted rates per 100,000 population
- Year: 2022 specifically
- Output: list of state names

## Queries
1. **High** - CDC 2022 age-adjusted heart disease death rates by state
2. **High** - CDC 2022 age-adjusted cancer death rates by state
3. **High** - CDC 2022 age-adjusted diabetes death rates by state

Based on the CDC 2022 age-adjusted death rate data (sourced from CDC WONDER via KFF State Health Facts), I've cross-referenced all three datasets. Here are the states meeting **all three thresholds**:

| State | Heart Disease | Cancer | Diabetes |
|-------|---------------|--------|----------|
| **Mississippi** | 248.0 | 178.4 | 34.7 |
| **Oklahoma** | 257.1 | 171.6 | 33.8 |
| **Arkansas** | 224.1 | 168.1 | 36.0 |
| **West Virginia** | 209.5 | 176.3 | 41.1 |

**Four states** exceeded all three thresholds in 2022.

---

## Verification Details

**Thresholds:**
- Heart disease > 191.5 per 100,000
- Cancer > 161.9 per 100,000  
- Diabetes > 33.1 per 100,000

**States that met 2 of 3 (for reference):**
- Kentucky: Heart (208.6) ✓, Cancer (177.3) ✓, Diabetes (29.4) ✗
- Tennessee: Heart (218.3) ✓, Cancer (162.3) ✓, Diabetes (31.2) ✗
- Louisiana: Heart (224.0) ✓, Cancer (160.3) ✗, Diabetes (29.9) ✗
- Indiana: Heart (185.0) ✗, Cancer (162.5) ✓, Diabetes (29.8) ✗

## Sources

1. **Heart disease**: KFF State Health Facts – "Heart Disease Deaths and Death Rates per 100,000 Population" (2022), sourced from CDC WONDER: https://www.kff.org/state-health-policy-data/state-indicator/heart-disease-deaths-and-death-rates-per-100000-population
2. **Cancer**: KFF State Health Facts – "Cancer Deaths and Death Rates per 100,000 Population" (2022), sourced from CDC WONDER: https://www.kff.org/state-health-policy-data/state-indicator/cancer-deaths-and-death-rates-per-100000
3. **Diabetes**: KFF State Health Facts – "Diabetes Deaths and Death Rates per 100,000 Population" (2022), sourced from CDC WONDER: https://www.kff.org/state-health-policy-data/state-indicator/diabetes-deaths-and-death-rates-per-100000

All rates are age-adjusted to the 2000 US standard population per 100,000.
